scope:
Fixed-design, same-request family replay plus a legal batching control.

Independent B=1 sums are work accounting, never a native execution timeline.
The batch control uses four distinct, simultaneously ready SimpleMem windows;
it preserves every L/O and explicitly charges padding and the shrinking tail.
tuning: Both hardware and fraction rule frozen on earlier Mem0 update before family replay.

algorithms.residency: Per-model separate profiling. 8B and 32B each have their own HB placement. Not simultaneously resident in one 10 GB HB cache; a mixed-model schedule must refill and account for evictions.

batch_control.limits: Controlled padded batch; no prefix reuse; completions only set work amount, no new answer quality assertion. Compact at real completion boundaries for free (optimistic software control).
